title: CD73/NT5E-mediated ubiquitination of AURKA regulates alcohol-related liver fibrosis via modulating hepatic stellate cell senescence.
authors: Liu, Zhenni; Wu, Baoming; Liu, Xueqi; Wu, Xue; Du, Jiyu; Xia, Guoqing; Cai, Junnan; Zhu, Hong; Sheng, Xiaodong; Zhang, Mengda; Xu, Junrui; Xu, Tao; Lv, Xiongwen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CD73/NT5E通过AURKA泛素化调控肝星状细胞衰老与酒精性肝纤维化，虽含分子对接但核心为蛋白-蛋白互作与疾病机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法。
abstract: Alcohol-related liver disease (ALD) is the most common chronic liver disease worldwide; however, no effective treatment to prevent the progression of alcohol-related liver fibrosis (ALF) is available. CD73/NT5E, a nucleotidase, controls cellular homeostasis by combining extracellular purinergic signaling with intracellular kinase activity and gene transcription and is associated with cell proliferation, differentiation, and death. In this study, we demonstrated that CD73/NT5E had a more significant regulatory effect on the activation, proliferation, and apoptosis of HSCs compared with that of CD39/ENTPD1. We examined the expression of CD73/NT5E in the normal and fibrotic human livers. The absence of CD73/NT5E was protective in mouse models of ALF. In addition, Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway analyses showed that CD73/NT5E overexpression was related to the p53 signaling pathway, which regulates cell senescence. Proteins interacting with p53 were predicted using the STRING database. The overlap between proteomic analysis and STRING databases was for Aurora kinase A (AURKA), a cell cycle-regulated kinase. Coimmunoprecipitation (co-IP) assay and molecular docking confirmed that CD73/NT5E directly interacted with AURKA. We found that overexpression of CD73/NT5E inhibited AURKA ubiquitination, whereas p53 signaling was downregulated. Mechanistically, CD73/NT5E regulated ALF and the activation and senescence of stellate cells by binding to AURKA. These findings indicate that CD73/NT5E is a potential therapeutic target for ALF.
abstract_zh: 酒精相关性肝病（ALD）是全球最常见的慢性肝病；然而，目前尚无有效治疗方法可阻止酒精相关性肝纤维化（ALF）的进展。CD73/NT5E 是一种核苷酸酶，通过将细胞外嘌呤能信号与细胞内激酶活性和基因转录相结合，控制细胞稳态，并与细胞增殖、分化和死亡相关。在本研究中，我们证明，与 CD39/ENTPD1 相比，CD73/NT5E 对肝星状细胞（HSCs）的活化、增殖和凋亡具有更显著的调节作用。我们检测了正常和纤维化人肝脏中 CD73/NT5E 的表达。CD73/NT5E 的缺失在 ALF 小鼠模型中具有保护作用。此外，京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）通路分析显示，CD73/NT5E 过表达与调控细胞衰老的 p53 信号通路相关。使用 STRING 数据库预测了与 p53 相互作用的蛋白质。蛋白质组学分析与 STRING 数据库的重叠部分为 Aurora 激酶 A（AURKA），一种细胞周期调控激酶。免疫共沉淀（co-IP）实验和分子对接证实 CD73/NT5E 与 AURKA 直接相互作用。我们发现，CD73/NT5E 的过表达抑制了 AURKA 的泛素化，而 p53 信号则被下调。机制上，CD73/NT5E 通过与 AURKA 结合来调节 ALF 以及星状细胞的活化和衰老。这些发现表明，CD73/NT5E 是 ALF 的潜在治疗靶点。
